entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. My name is Ashley. How can I help you today?
Finally! I've been on hold forever. I need to return something. A VeloBand Pulse I ordered a couple of weeks ago. This thing is useless!

I understand your frustration, sir. I'm sorry for the wait time. I can certainly help you with a return. Could you please provide me with your order number or the email address associated with the purchase of the VeloBand Pulse?
It's under j.doe@email.com. Hurry this up, I don't have all day.

Thank you. Let me pull up your order details. Okay, I see the VeloBand Pulse purchased on... May 1st. Regarding our return policy, generally, we offer a full refund within 90 days of purchase. Is there anything wrong with the smart watch?
90 days? Well that's good news at least. Yes, it doesn't track my heart rate accurately. I've had it for about 15 days now. I thought I was stuck with it. The information online was so confusing.

I apologize for any confusion regarding our return policy. Since you are within the 90 days, I can go ahead and process the return for the VeloBand Pulse. I will send you a prepaid shipping label to your email address. Once we receive the returned item, a full refund will be issued to your original payment method. Could you confirm your shipping address for the label?
That's great! The shipping address is the same as on the order, John Doe, 123 Main Street, Anytown, USA.

Perfect. The prepaid shipping label has been emailed to j.doe@email.com. Just print it out, affix it to the package containing the VeloBand Pulse, and drop it off at any authorized carrier location. Please allow 7-10 business days for the refund to appear in your account after we receive the return. If you have any more questions about the return policy, please don't hesitate to ask. Sometimes the 10 days for certain electronics causes confusion, but you're well within the timeframe.
Fantastic! You've been a great help. Thank you so much for making this easy.
You're very welcome, Mr. Doe. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
You're very welcome! Have a great day, and thank you for choosing VeloFit! If you require further assistance, you can reach out to a manager for escalations.
